cover_headline: Infosys in Talks With DOJ Over Investigation Into H-1B Classifications
facts: In 2013, Infosys paid $34 million to settle a US government probe into alleged immigration violations
The probe concerns the employer's filings, not individual workers' status
Indian nationals receive the largest share of H-1B approvals

end.headline: Infosys in Talks With DOJ Over Investigation Into H-1B Classifications
end.line: Infosys is in discussions with the US Department of Justice over an investigation into how it classified certain H-1B visa holders in immigration filings.
